title.purpose: Session title on the session card, settings page titles.

readout.purpose: Measured values in fixed digit slots (.scope-readout).

label.purpose: Name of a measurement, beside its readout (.scope-label).

shadows.name: own-space-lift
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 42%, transparent), 0 6px 16px -8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 70%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Active titlebar tab and selected project row.

shadows.name: space-focus
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 58%, transparent), 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 14%, transparent)

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Background, color and shadow changes on tabs, rows, nav, focus.

motion.name: chroma-cycle
motion.purpose: Optional RGB cycle on live elements; only when enabled and Lite mode is off; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: lite-mode
motion.purpose: Default on; stops continuous animation, spinners exempt.

components.name: Titlebar Tab
components.description: Soft pills; inactive keep a faint tint of their own space, the open one fills with it.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; background: #07080b; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; font: 440 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #c7cede; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 10%, #07080b); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 16%, #17181e); } .ds-tab-active { color: #eef0f6; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 24%, #17181e); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 42%, transparent), 0 6px 16px -8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 70%, transparent); } .ds-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--own-space); color: #0b0b10; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Floating card that lights in the space color while you write; send filled with the space.
components.html: Ask anything, / for commands
components.css: .ds-composer { --space: #9b7bff; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 96px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 8%, transparent), transparent 65%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 7%, #17181e); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 24px 56px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 22%, transparent); transition: box-shadow 160ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-composer:focus-within, .ds-composer:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 24px 56px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 58%, transparent), 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 14%, transparent); } .ds-composer-text { align-self: flex-start; font: 440 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(238 240 246 / 0.5); } .ds-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--space); color: #04070a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--space) 70%, transparent), 0 0 18px -4px var(--space); transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-send:active { transform: scale(0.94); }

components.name: Session Card
components.description: Rounded panel with a still wash of the space color at its top.
components.css: .ds-session { --space: #9b7bff; min-height: 220px; padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 14px; background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 6%, #111217); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 28%, transparent) 0, color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 5%, transparent) 180px, transparent 420px); background-repeat: no-repeat; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035) inset, 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 10px 28px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 12%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #eef0f6; } .ds-session h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-session p { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: #c7cede; }

components.name: Home Project Row
components.description: Projects listed as spaces; hover tints, selected fills with the project's own color.
components.css: .ds-projects { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 240px; } .ds-project { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: transparent; font: 440 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #c7cede; text-align: left; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-project:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 12%, transparent); } .ds-project-selected { color: #eef0f6; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 22%, #17181e); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 40%, transparent), 0 8px 20px -12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--own-space) 80%, transparent); } .ds-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--own-space); color: #0b0b10; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Settings Search
components.description: Search-first settings field; focus lights in the space color.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input placeholder="Search settings"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { --space: #9b7bff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 220px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 6%, #111217); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 16%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08)); color: #8a8f9c; transition: box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 60%, transparent), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 18%, transparent); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: #eef0f6; font: 440 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--space); }

components.name: Settings Nav Item
components.description: The page you are on wears the space color; hover stays a faint tint.
components.css: .ds-nav { --space: #9b7bff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 200px; padding: 14px 12px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 10%, transparent), transparent 55%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 7%, #17181e); } .ds-nav-item { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #c7cede; font: 440 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover:not(.ds-nav-selected) { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 10%, #1d1e26); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--space); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-selected { color: #eef0f6; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 22%, #1d1e26); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 38%, transparent); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Round chips for example prompts and settings 'also in' pages.
components.css: .ds-chips { --space: #9b7bff; display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 8%, #1d1e26); color: #c7cede; font: 440 12px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 16%, #17181e); color: #eef0f6; } .ds-chip-page { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 18%, #1d1e26); color: #eef0f6; } .ds-chip-page:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--space) 30%, #1d1e26); }

components.name: Readout
components.description: Mono label beside its measured value, digits in fixed slots.
components.css: .ds-readout { font: 400 12px ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #eef0f6; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-label { margin-right: 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8f9c; } .ds-ghost { color: rgb(220 226 240 / 0.18); }

narrative.overview:
Every project is a space with a color of its own, and the app takes on the tone of the space you are in. The ground and every panel lean toward that hue; the color itself lands only on what is yours and active: the open tab, the selected project or settings page, focus, and the send button. You know where you are by color alone. Home, which belongs to no project, is the violet space.

The world is built from one variable. `html[data-space]` (set by the tab in use through `enterSpace`) picks `--space` from nine hues, and every neutral, border, wash and accent derives from it with `color-mix`, so a new space is one line. Surfaces are rounded cards (14 to 20px) lifted off a near-black ground with soft shadows that have a real offset. The app stays open all day, so it is calm at rest: backgrounds never move, Lite mode (on by default) stops continuous animation, and the optional RGB cycle for live work exists only when the user turns it on and Lite mode is off.

It refuses the grey chat app with one static blue accent. Tokens live in `packages/ui/src/v2/styles/scope.css`; the shell's use of them lives in `packages/app/src/spaces.css`.
keyCharacteristics: Nine space hues; one of them is the app's accent at any moment, chosen by the project in use.
Near-black neutrals tinted 6 to 10% toward the space hue; no pure grey surfaces.
The space color marks only what is yours and active; everything else stays in tinted neutrals.
Rounded cards with soft offset shadows and a hairline in the space tone.
A quiet wash of the space color at the top of the session card and the composer, painted once.
Errors and warnings keep fixed colors in every space.

rules.name: The Yours-and-Active Rule
rules.body: The space color marks only what is yours and active: the active tab, focus, the send button, the selected project, the selected settings page. Everything else, including hovers, stays in space-tinted neutrals (hover tints stay at 9 to 12%).

rules.name: The One Space Rule
rules.body: The app wears one space at a time. The only other hues on screen are each tab's and project row's own color (`--own-space`), shown at a faint 10% tint when inactive and filled at 22 to 24% when selected.

rules.name: The Fixed State Rule
rules.body: Errors and warnings never take the space color and never cycle.

rules.name: The Label-Beside Rule
rules.body: A mono label sits on the same line as its readout (`HOJE R$ 0,00`), never as a small heading above a title or section.

rules.name: The Still Ground Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds never animate. The top wash on the session card and the workspace glow (two radial gradients of the space at 14% and 8%) are painted once.

dos: **Do** derive every new color from `--space` with `color-mix`; a new surface should change tone when the space changes.
**Do** give the space color only to what is yours and active: active tab, focus, send, selected project or page.
**Do** show a project's own color through `--own-space` on its tab and row, faint when inactive, filled when selected.
**Do** lift cards with the Raised / Floating / Overlay shadows and step surfaces through Layers 01 to 04.
**Do** keep errors at `#ff5a4e` and warnings at `#f5b33c` (dark) in every space.
**Do** respect Lite mode (on by default): continuous animations stop, one-shot ones finish in 1ms, spinners stay.
**Do** set mono labels beside their readouts, in fixed digit slots.
donts: **Don't** animate backgrounds, washes or the workspace glow.
**Don't** run the RGB cycle unless the user turned it on and Lite mode is off.
**Don't** paint the space color on hovers, idle rows or decoration beyond a 12% tint.
**Don't** add texture, grids or backdrop blur to panels.
**Don't** replace project avatars with dots or glyphs; they are rounded squares with the project's initial.
**Don't** use a mono uppercase label as a kicker above a heading.
